# Bispebjerg Abdominalcenter

Bispebjerg Abdominalcenter is a surgical unit documented in the Danish IBD registry (DANIBD) for its performance on key quality indicators in inflammatory bowel disease treatment. The center is tracked as part of a national quality assurance program that monitors both medical and surgical care across Denmark's IBD services.

The center's most significant documented finding concerns its re-operation rate for surgical procedures. Bispebjerg Abdominalcenter reported a re-operation rate of 17% [^src1], which exceeds the national development target of 8%. This metric measures the proportion of patients who require a second surgical procedure within 30 days of their initial operation—a key indicator of surgical quality and patient safety. The re-operation rate appears in the 2024 DANIBD annual report alongside data from other Danish abdominal surgery centers, as part of a broader assessment of surgical outcomes in inflammatory bowel disease care.

The data provided offers no information about the center's organizational structure, history, medical staff, or other surgical quality metrics. The single documented reference captures one measurement at one point in time without context about trends, causes, or improvement efforts.
